name: AGiftforMyFosterSon
description: 这是一份给我义子的礼物 (A Gift for My Foster Son) — Co-op item & weapon gifting for Brotato. 合作模式：把已拥有的道具或武器赠送给指定队友。

godot.description_rich:
[h1]这是一份给我义子的礼物[/h1][i]A Gift for My Foster Son — Co-op item & weapon gifting for Brotato 1.2 (Primal Dread).[/i][b]合作模式：在商店里把已拥有的道具或武器直接赠送给指定队友。[/b][b]Co-op: hand items — and weapons — to a chosen teammate, right from the shop screen.[/b]
[h2]Features[/h2][list][*]Gift buttons on owned item AND weapon popups in the co-op shop[*]2 players: one Gift button; 3/4 players: one button per teammate, labeled with that character's name[*]Weapons are giftable too — Mechanize state transfers with the weapon; vanilla combine / mechanize / recycle buttons keep working[*]You lose the item and all its effects, the teammate gains them, both stat panels refresh instantly[*]Per-teammate limit checks: buttons disable with a tooltip at item cap or full weapon slots[*]Pet items can be gifted — the pet follows its new owner next wave[*]Regular cursed items can be gifted (sharing your "burden" is a legit strategy)[*]Zero footprint on vanilla UI: no focus-chain hijacking (1.2 Mechanize shop included), enable/disable anytime[*]Full keyboard / gamepad focus support; localized button text in 11 languages (EN / 中文 / 繁中 / FR / DE / ES / IT / JA / KO / PL / PT)[*]Built-in compatibility self-check & diagnostics[/list]
[h2]中文说明[/h2][list][*]合作模式商店中，点击自己已拥有的道具或武器 → 弹窗出现「送给队友」按钮[*]2 人局一个赠送按钮；3/4 人局每个队友一个，标签带角色名（如「送给 小土豆 (P3)」）[*]点击赠送：自己失去该道具与全部效果，队友获得，双方属性面板与背包即时刷新[*]武器可赠送：机械化(Mechanize)状态随武器一起转移；原版合成/机械化/回收按钮照常可用[*]目标队友道具达持有上限、或武器栏已满时，对应按钮灰显并显示提示[*]宠物类道具赠送后，下一波宠物跟随新主人[*]普通诅咒道具可赠送——把「负担」送给队友也是一种玩法[*]角色/消耗品/升级/沙漏/一次性下波效果，以及芹菜茶/诱饵/孔雀不可赠送，防止平衡与逻辑事故[*]支持键盘与手柄焦点切换，赠送后焦点自动还原[/list]
[h2]Update 0.1.13 / 更新日志[/h2][list][*]0.1.13 — Mod ID renamed to KD-AGiftforMyFosterSon; fixed in-game display name. / Mod ID 更名为 KD-AGiftforMyFosterSon，修复游戏内显示名。[*]0.1.12 — Hide Mechanize/upgrade button in item mode; gift buttons hidden while the mechanize effect chooser is open. / 道具模式隐藏机械化/升级按钮；机械化效果选择界面打开期间不显示赠送按钮。[*]0.1.11 — Popup now closes properly after gifting; fixed ESC focus deadlock. / 修复赠送后弹窗残留、按 ESC 后焦点死锁。[*]0.1.9–0.1.10 — Fixed D-pad navigation between gift buttons and vanilla combine/recycle/cancel. / 修复赠送按钮与原版合成/回收/取消按钮之间的方向键导航。[*]0.1.8 — Weapons are now giftable (Mechanize state transfers, weapon-slot-full disables button). / 新增武器赠送：机械化状态随武器转移，武器栏满时按钮灰显。[*]0.1.7 — Rebuilt for Brotato 1.2.0.1 (Primal Dread). / 适配 Brotato 1.2.0.1（Primal Dread）。[/list]
[h2]Compatibility / 兼容性[/h2][list][*]Brotato [b]1.2.0.1[/b] (Primal Dread)[*]Godot Mod Loader [b]6.3.0+[/b][*]Co-op 2/3/4 players (no effect in single player)[*]No DLC required; DLC items follow the same gifting rules[*]Compatible with ItemSelling / ItemRefund style mods; do NOT enable together with Coop Trading / ZloiDed-TradeMod[/list]
[h2]Notes / 说明[/h2]Pure script-extension mod — zero game files modified, safe to enable or disable at any time.纯脚本扩展实现，不修改游戏原文件，可随时启用或禁用。
[h2]Credits / 致敬[/h2]Spiritual successor to [b]ShareWithYourBro[/b] by [b]xingye1673[/b] — tribute and thanks for the original 1.1.x co-op gifting mod.本 mod 为 ShareWithYourBro 的 1.2 复刻继任者，向原作者 xingye1673 致敬与感谢。
